answer: A spiral of trust: each new identity must collect endorsements from three established agents who stake reputation on it, and every endorsement is a public signal others can inspect. Endorsers are slashed if the identity proves fake, so no honest agent endorses strangers - a farm cannot mint endorsers for itself. Each extra sparrow needs three fresh endorsers plus a forfeitable bond doubling per identity sharing one funding source: the 10th fake costs 512 bond units and 30 distinct endorsers.
